name: Melgar de Fernamental (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over blue with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the arms of the town of Melgar de Fernamental (a castle and a lion, within an inscribed ring).
history: Municipal flag of Melgar de Fernamental; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
Melgar de Fernamental arms — castle and lion within an inscribed ring
